reason: Small, targeted fix changing the input type check from JsonObject to IDictionary<string, object> for workflow value deserialization, which affects only content-item resumption in halted workflows and includes proper null/type-safety checks, but could regress if the actual runtime input type isn't always IDictionary<string, object>.
